spells.name: Dirty Fighting
spells.summary: Every three hits from Akshan's Attacks and Abilities deals bonus damage and grants him a Shield if the target was a champion. When Akshan Attacks, he fires an additional Attack for reduced damage. If he cancels the additional Attack, he instead gains Move Speed.
spells.text: After launching an Attack, Akshan will fire an additional shot for (50% Attack Damage) physical damage. He can cancel this shot to instead gain (20 ~ 75) × (1 + 100% bonus Attack Speed) Move Speed decaying over 1 second. Every three hits from Attacks or Abilities deals an additional ((15 ~ 150) + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Against champions, Akshan also gains ((40 ~ 280) + (35% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield for 2 seconds ((16 ~ 4) second Cooldown).

spells.name: Avengerang
spells.summary: Akshan throws a boomerang that deals damage going out and coming back, extending its range each time it hits an enemy.
spells.text: Akshan throws a boomerang that deals (45/75/105/135/165 + (70% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, extending the range each time an enemy is hit. Champion hits grant Akshan (20% + (5% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed decaying over 1 second. Deals 40/50/60/70/80% damage to non-champions. Enemies hit are briefly revealed.

spells.name: Going Rogue
spells.summary: Akshan passively marks enemy champions as Scoundrels when they kill his ally champions. If Akshan kills a Scoundrel, he resurrects the allies they killed, gains bonus gold, and clears all marks. When activated, Akshan enters camouflage and gains Move Speed and Mana Regen while moving towards Scoundrels. Akshan loses the camouflage quickly while he is not in brush or near terrain.
spells.text: Passive: Enemy champions that kill Akshan's allies become Scoundrels for 60 seconds. Takedowns on a Scoundrel within 3 seconds of being damaged by Akshan grant him 100 Gold, resurrects the slain allies, and removes all other Scoundrels. Active: Akshan becomes Camouflaged for 2 seconds or indefinitely while he is near a wall or in brush. While Camouflaged in this way, Akshan also gains 80/90/100/110/120 Move Speed and 12% missing Mana regen while moving towards Scoundrels. Passive: Enemy champions that kill Akshan's allies become Scoundrels for 60 seconds. Takedowns on a Scoundrel within 3 seconds of being damaged by Akshan grant him and his partner 100 Gold and removes all other Scoundrels. Active: Akshan becomes Camouflaged for 2 seconds or indefinitely while he is near a wall or in brush. While Camouflaged in this way, Akshan also gains 80/90/100/110/120 Move Speed and 12% missing Mana regen while moving towards Scoundrels. Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius. While active, Akshan also sees trails leading to Scoundrels. Akshan can only claim Scoundrels when he is alive.

spells.name: Heroic Swing
spells.summary: Akshan fires a grappling hook into terrain then swings around it, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy while swinging. He can jump off early or gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain.
spells.text: First Cast: Akshan fires a grappling hook, attaching to the first terrain hit. Second Cast: Akshan swings around the terrain, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy for (8/16/24/32/40 + (25% Attack Damage)) × (1 + 30% bonus Attack Speed) physical damage per shot. Third Cast: Akshan dives off the rope, firing a final shot. Colliding with an enemy Champion or terrain ends the swing early. Champion takedowns refresh this Ability's Cooldown. Akshan prioritizes shooting champions marked by Dirty Fighting. On-hits while swinging are 25% effective. Damage is increased by 30% of bonus Attack Speed. Attacks can critically strike for (8/16/24/32/40 + (25% Attack Damage)) × (1 + 30% bonus Attack Speed) × (0.5 + 50% Critical Strike Damage) physical damage.

spells.name: Comeuppance
spells.summary: Akshan locks onto an enemy champion and starts storing bullets. When released, he fires all stored bullets, dealing damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion, or structure hit.
spells.text: Akshan locks onto a champion and begins overcharging his gun for up to 2.5 seconds, storing up to 5/6/7 bullets. Recast: Akshan unleashes the stored bullets, each dealing at least (25/35/45 + (15% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy or structure hit, increased up to (75/105/135 + (45% Attack Damage)) physical damage based on missing Health. Bullets execute minions and apply Lifesteal. Bullet damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 30% effectiveness.

spells.name: Gift of the Drowned Ones
spells.summary: When Pyke is hidden from enemies, he regenerates damage that he has recently taken from champions. Pyke also cannot gain extra Maximum Health from any source, and instead gains Bonus AD.
spells.text: Pyke stores (9% + (0.2% Lethality)) of damage taken from champions, increased to (40% + (0.4% Lethality)) when there's more than one enemy nearby. Pyke can store up to (80 + (800% bonus Attack Damage)) damage. While unseen by enemies, he rapidly regenerates this stored damage. Additionally, Pyke converts all Maximum Health increases to Attack Damage instead at a rate of 14 Health to 1 Attack Damage.

spells.name: Bone Skewer
spells.summary: Pyke either stabs an enemy in front of him or pulls an enemy towards him.
spells.text: Tap: Pyke stabs, dealing (100/150/200/250/300 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit, preferring champions. They are then Slowed by 90% for 1 second. Hold: Pyke throws his harpoon, dealing (100/150/200/250/300 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit and Pulling them towards him. They are then Slowed by 90% for 1 second. If Pyke successfully hits an enemy champion or the channel does not complete successfully, 75% of the Mana cost is refunded.

spells.name: Ghostwater Dive
spells.summary: Pyke enters Camouflage and gains significant Move Speed that decays over time.
spells.text: Pyke gains Camouflage and (45 + (200% Lethality))Move Speed decaying over 5 seconds. Move Speed scales with Lethality. Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.

spells.name: Phantom Undertow
spells.summary: Pyke dashes and leaves behind a phantom that will return to him, stunning enemy champions along its path.
spells.text: Pyke dashes, leaving a drowned phantom behind him that returns to him shortly. The phantom Stuns for (1.25 + (1% Lethality)) seconds and deals (100/150/200/250/300 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to champions. Stun duration scales with Lethality.

spells.name: Death From Below
spells.summary: Pyke blinks to and executes low health enemies, allowing him to cast this spell again and granting additional gold to an ally who assists.
spells.text: Pyke strikes all enemy champions in an X, teleporting to and executing targets below ((250 ~ 550) + (80% bonus Attack Damage) + (150% Lethality)) Health. Champions above the threshold and non-champions instead take physical damage equal to 50% of that amount (((125 ~ 275) + (40% bonus Attack Damage) + (75% Lethality))). When an enemy champion dies inside the X, Pyke can Recast this Ability for free within 20 seconds. If he executed that champion, the last assisting ally will also get kill gold. If he did not, he will still get kill gold as if he did.
